The six setup files in this folder

These are the circuit files and setup keys of Privacy Pools v1, copied byte for byte and never edited. The device
makes proofs with them, and the vault's verifying keys come from the two .vkey files. Anything that reads them must
first check each file's sha256 against packages/kit/src/zk/setup-files.ts.

Source: https://github.com/0xbow-io/privacy-pools-core, tag v1.3.0, commit c312dcd58f6ad085204be61923c49f8065e4e9ae,
under packages/circuits/. Fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com at that commit on 2026-11-01 01:02Z.

File              Bytes       sha256                                                            Path at the source
withdraw.wasm     2,607,967   36cda22791def3d520a55c0fc808369cd5849532a75fab65686e666ed3d55c10  build/withdraw/withdraw_js/withdraw.wasm
withdraw.zkey     17,793,015  2a893b42174c813566e5c40c715a8b90cd49fc4ecf384e3a6024158c3d6de677  trusted-setup/final-keys/withdraw.zkey
withdraw.vkey     4,208       666bd0983b20c1611543b04f7712e067fbe8cad69f07ada8a310837ff398d21e  trusted-setup/final-keys/withdraw.vkey
commitment.wasm   2,380,442   254d2130607182fd6fd1aee67971526b13cfe178c88e360da96dce92663828d8  build/commitment/commitment_js/commitment.wasm
commitment.zkey   901,233     494ae92d64098fda2a5649690ddc5821fcd7449ca5fe8ef99ee7447544d7e1f3  trusted-setup/final-keys/commitment.zkey
commitment.vkey   3,477       7d48b4eb3dedc12fb774348287b587f0c18c3c7254cd60e9cf0f8b3636a570d8  trusted-setup/final-keys/commitment.vkey

The .zkey files are the outputs of Privacy Pools' public setup ceremony (514 contributions for withdraw and 513 for
commitment, each closed by a random beacon). The one-contribution development keys of the source
(build/*/groth16_pkey.zkey) are not here and are never used.

Licences

1. Privacy Pools v1: Apache License 2.0, "Copyright 2025 0XBOW LTD" (the source's LICENSE, line 189, at the commit
   above). The Apache License 2.0 text is this repository's LICENSE file. The source has no NOTICE file.

2. circomlib: the circuits include circomlib 2.0.5 (the source's packages/circuits/package.json, line 34), so the two
   .wasm files and the keys are built in part from it. At that version circomlib has no licence file and its
   package.json says "license": "GPL-3.0" (line 25, at https://github.com/iden3/circomlib commit
   cff5ab6288b55ef23602221694a6a38a0239dcc0). The circomlib repository's licence today is LGPL-3.0. Both texts are
   here, as LICENSE-GPL-3.0.txt and LICENSE-LGPL-3.0.txt (from gnu.org, 2026-11-01).

These files keep their own licences. They are shipped unchanged, in their own folder, and are not relicensed under
this repository's licence.

The source code of the circuits is public: packages/circuits/circuits/ (withdraw.circom, commitment.circom,
merkleTree.circom) at the Privacy Pools commit above, and circomlib at the commit above.
